title: Vực thẳm
about: Round x2 of the dark ambient style (khong-gian): the abyss, the darkest and lowest. The pad held deep (under middle C), the sub, the drone, a great bell very low on every second chord; nothing high at all. D minor at 42 bpm, sinking by half steps (D, C sharp, C) as it goes. An original piece.
